caseName: Donovan Construction Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: DONOVAN CONSTRUCTION COMPANY AND JAMES CONSTRUCTION COMPANY, A JOINT VENTURE, DOING BUSINESS AS DONOVAN-JAMES COMPANY v. United States

opinions.text:
Contract; extra costs. Petition dismissed.

Plaintiffs’ petition for writ of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court October 14, 1957.
